headline: RBI to conduct ₹50,000 crore overnight VRR auction under LAF on November 25, 2026
summary_points: RBI will hold an overnight Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under LAF on Wednesday, November 25, 2026.
The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions.
Operational guidelines remain as per Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.
who_is_affected: Banks and other LAF-eligible participants managing short-term liquidity, and treasury teams tracking money market conditions.
action_required: Eligible participants wishing to bid should do so within the 09:30-10:00 AM window on November 25, 2026, following the 2022 operational guidelines.

social.linkedin:
RBI to conduct an Overnight Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF).

Key details:
- Auction date: Wednesday, November 25, 2026
- Notified amount: ₹50,000 crore
- Tenor: 1 day
- Window: 09:30 AM to 10:00 AM
- Reversal: Thursday, November 26, 2026

The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions. Operational guidelines remain the same as those in Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.

For treasury teams, banks and finance professionals, this is a useful signal of the RBI's near-term liquidity management stance.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1555) before acting.
